tasks.label: Stop Backend API
tasks.command: $conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5092 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $conn) { Write-Output 'No dotnet process listening on port 5092'; exit 0 }; $proc = Get-Process -Id $conn.OwningProcess -ErrorAction Stop; if ($proc.ProcessName -ne 'dotnet') { Write-Error ('Refusing to stop process ''{0}'' on port 5092' -f $proc.ProcessName); exit 1 }; Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force; Write-Output ('Stopped dotnet process {0} on port 5092' -f $proc.Id)

tasks.label: Force Stop Port 5092
tasks.command: $conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5092 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $conn) { Write-Output 'No listening process on port 5092'; exit 0 }; Stop-Process -Id $conn.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output ('Stopped process {0} on port 5092' -f $conn.OwningProcess)
